Never publish them or commit them to a public repo. Room 6 (bathroom, 1.705 x 2.40 m inside: x 8.9017..10.6069, y 14.2486..16.6474; door in the south wall at x 8.94..9.59, hinged at its west end (8.94, 14.24), swings INTO the bathroom (quarter circle r 0.65, up to y 14.89); sconces on the west wall at y 14.867 and 15.884, 1.95 m up; socket on the west wall at y 16.334, 1.10 m up; switch on the south wall at x 9.768). x, y = footprint centre in plan metres (x right, y up); rot_deg = world rotation.y = plan angle CCW; the piece's front (+z) faces plan angle rot_deg - 90 (0 = south, 90 = east, 180 = north, 270 = west). "wall": true = wall-mounted: x, y is the point on the wall face, the back sits on it, "lift" = height of the lowest point. "tilt_deg": the model is rotated about its own x axis first (the mirror is modelled lying flat). "kind" = drawn from code (IKEA sells no tubs, WCs, screens or shower sets): the url is the real shop product it stands for. "parent"/"local" = placed in the parent's frame [x across, height, z towards the front].
